name: NYC 311 Service Request
description: A public NYC 311 service request prepared for structured and semantic search demos.

schema.$comment: A search-friendly projection of NYC Open Data 311 service requests.

requestId.description: The stable Unique Key assigned by NYC Open Data.

submittedAt.description: The NYC local date and time when the request was submitted, as supplied by the source dataset.

closedAt.description: The NYC local date and time when the request was closed, as supplied by the source dataset.

agency.description: The abbreviation of the city agency responsible for the request.

agencyName.description: The full name of the city agency responsible for the request.

problem.description: The broad problem or complaint category.

problemDetail.description: The primary detail describing the problem.

additionalDetails.description: Additional detail supplied for the problem.

locationType.description: The kind of place where the issue occurred.

status.description: The current request status in the source dataset.

dueAt.description: The NYC local due date and time, as supplied by the source dataset.

resolutionDescription.description: The agency's public explanation of the resolution or next action.

resolutionUpdatedAt.description: The NYC local date and time when the resolution was last updated, as supplied by the source dataset.

channel.description: The channel used to submit the request.

incidentAddress.description: The street address associated with the incident.

streetName.description: The street associated with the incident.

intersectionStreet1.description: The first street when the incident location is an intersection.

intersectionStreet2.description: The second street when the incident location is an intersection.

landmark.description: A landmark associated with the incident location.

city.description: The city or locality associated with the incident.

borough.description: The NYC borough associated with the incident.

communityBoard.description: The community board associated with the incident.

councilDistrict.description: The city council district associated with the incident.

policePrecinct.description: The police precinct associated with the incident.

latitude.description: The incident latitude in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: The incident longitude in decimal degrees.
